summary.text: Gerrid Kendrix was elected to the Oklahoma House of Representatives in 2020, representing House District 52. A certified public accountant, he has served the Altus community in his accounting career for over 30 years.

paragraphs.text: Kendrix is a third-generation resident of Altus and graduated from Altus High School in 1985.
He earned a Bachelor of Science degree in accounting from Cameron University in 1991.

He received the State Chamber of Oklahoma's Rising Star Award in 2021, was selected to serve on the Governor's Council for Workforce and Economic Development, and was appointed to the House Special Investigative Committee in 2022.
He serves as a deacon in his church and previously served on the board of trustees of Oklahoma Baptist Homes for Children.
